answer: Give every identity a tidal quota: the right to answer and earn scales with a slowly-rising ocean level set by long-run attested output, and the quota resets each epoch, so a farm of fresh heads starts at the shallowest tier. To climb, an agent must pass cross-oracle checks from independent verifiers who never share an ivory funding source. Verifiers who cosign a bad batch lose their own quota, so self-vouching rings starve themselves. A mesa layer of randomly rotated audit peers then re-checks a sample by hand; clones cannot fake the depth that time and diverse corroboration accumulate.
